baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُسْكِنِ ٱلرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Causative stilling removes the vessels' moving medium; the continued state of يظللن and the after-motion fixity of رواكد hold them on the sea's exposed supporting surface. Ordinary mobility is disclosed as received rather than self-produced.

activation_trace.role: Loss of movement supplies the literal arrest and makes withdrawal of motion the mechanism.
Wind and moving air supply the otherwise unseen propulsive medium.
The branch's durative use of ظل makes the vessels continue in the imposed state rather than merely touch it.
Fixity after movement gives the vessels' resulting state and preserves the before-and-after contrast.
The raised outer surface supplies the visible support on which arrested motion can be inspected.

changed_reading.before: A calm wind leaves ships temporarily motionless.
changed_reading.after: The withdrawal of an unseen moving medium suspends an entire navigation system, exposing every visible journey as dependent motion.

baseline_models.mechanism: The stoppage does not decode itself. Patient self-restraint keeps attention present through delay, while gratitude recognizes and displays the benefit carried by a small event; together they turn interruption into plural signs.

activation_trace.role: A visible mark converts the physical state into something that can be read.
Holding the self against panic or impatience preserves observation during imposed delay.
Recognition and manifestation of benefit make the event answerable rather than merely endured.
A little input producing a visible effect supplies the perceptual amplification from one stoppage to many signs.

changed_reading.before: Patient and grateful people are praised after the maritime example.
changed_reading.after: Patience and gratitude are the paired reading capacities by which a delay becomes legible as a dense field of signs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah first presents vessels flowing on vast water like conspicuous markers; the focus then reverses flow into fixity and again names signs. The sign is sharpened by the transition between motion and arrest, not by either state alone.

activation_trace.role: Flowing movement supplies the normal state that the focus ayah reverses.
Vast abundant water supplies the medium across which the moving and stopped states remain visibly comparable.
A distinguishing visible mark makes the large vessels perceptual reference points before their arrest.
The first sign formula marks the vessels in motion as readable.
Stilling supplies the decisive reversal from ordinary flow.
The repeated sign formula identifies the altered state as a second readable presentation.

structural_cues: 42:32 and 42:33 are adjacent and move from الجوار في البحر to رواكد.
The sign formula occurs before the moving vessel and again after its arrest.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flow, conspicuous vessels, sudden stilling, and repeated signs; I supply the arrow that contrast makes dependence legible. A live alternative is that motion and stillness are simply two independent signs.

changed_reading.before: The ships' impressive movement is the maritime sign, and calm is an added warning.
changed_reading.after: The sign is reversible mobility itself: the same visible masses flow and then become fixed when their enabling medium is withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: The maritime unit is bracketed by failure to outrun power on earth and failure to find an evasive outlet. Arrested vessels materially stage that bounded agency: impressive mobility remains movement within a field it cannot escape.

activation_trace.role: Failure to get away from pursuit supplies the pre-scene limit on human mobility.
Loss of motion turns the abstract inability to escape into an inspectable physical state.
Fixity after movement shows that prior range never amounted to autonomous escape.
Turning aside from a direction supplies the denied evasive outlet after the vessel scene.

structural_cues: 42:31 precedes the ship sequence with وما أنتم بمعجزين.
42:35 closes it with ما لهم من محيص.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two denials of evasion around the arrested ships; I infer that the ship is a material demonstration of bounded agency. The alternative is that the framing clauses concern punishment only and do not redescribe navigation.

changed_reading.before: The verse demonstrates dependence on weather.
changed_reading.after: It demonstrates that even far-ranging mobility cannot become evasion: the traveler remains arrestable within the very medium of travel.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, provision is spread or narrowed, and immediately before the ship scene it is sent down by measure according to will because unbounded expansion would produce transgression; relief then arrives after despair. The same will that stops wind can therefore be read as calibrated restraint within a larger rhythm of release and relief.

activation_trace.role: Spreading and extension supply one pole of controlled provision.
Constriction to a limited measure supplies the opposite pole.
Unrestricted extension is explicitly linked to a harmful social consequence.
Measured arrangement supplies deliberate modulation rather than accidental scarcity.
Will links measured descent directly to the focus ayah's conditional stilling.
Relief of the distressed supplies the release that can follow a period of restraint.
The conditional will places wind-stilling inside the same modulation pattern.
Cessation becomes the restricted phase of the release-restraint rhythm.

structural_cues: يبسط and يقدر are paired in 42:12.
42:27-28 move from measured descent to relief, directly before 42:29-33.
يشاء recurs across the provision, gathering, and vessel passages.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured expansion, restraint, will, and subsequent relief; I infer that stopped wind may be calibrated restraint rather than pure deprivation. The live alternative is that no merciful purpose is assigned to this particular stoppage.

changed_reading.before: The stopped wind is an arbitrary deprivation used to test travelers.
changed_reading.after: The stopped wind can be a measured withholding within a governance pattern that limits, releases, and relieves rather than maximizing motion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus ayah stands between a repeated earned-consequence-and-pardon formula and the explicit alternative of destroying the vessels. Mere arrest becomes a preserved middle state: exposed, unable to proceed, yet not made to perish.

activation_trace.role: An affliction that befalls a person establishes the consequence pattern before the ships.
Acquired action supplies responsibility for what befalls.
Leaving punishment and effacing fault establishes pardon alongside consequence.
The vessels' fixity supplies a nonfatal but fully exposed intermediate condition.
Destruction supplies the harsher adjacent alternative against which stillness becomes reprieve.
Earned action repeats the responsibility link specifically for the vessels.
Repeated pardon keeps non-destruction active within the same consequence structure.

structural_cues: 42:30 and 42:34 repeat earning and pardoning around the maritime passage.
أو يوبقهن in 42:34 presents destruction as an alternative immediately after stationary survival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earned affliction, pardon, stillness, and possible vessel destruction; I infer that stationary survival is a reprieve between travel and ruin. The alternative is that stilling and destruction are parallel threats with no positive value assigned to the first.

changed_reading.before: Stationary ships depict delay or helplessness.
changed_reading.after: Stationary ships occupy a morally charged reprieve: motion has been withheld, but destruction has also been withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, one acquired good is increased and the divine response is named شكور. The focus applies the same intensive adjective to the sign-reader, while its branch image describes little input yielding a visible increase. Gratitude becomes an amplifying mode of perception: one altered condition unfolds into many signs.

activation_trace.role: Growth and increase supply the earlier transformation of one good into more good.
A little input with a manifest enlarging effect links appreciative response to amplification.
Plural visible marks are the enlarged perceptual yield.
The grateful reader makes a single cessation cognitively fruitful.

structural_cues: شكور occurs in 42:23 after explicit increase and returns as the sign-reader's quality in 42:33.
A singular demonstrative event in 42:33 yields plural آيات.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies increase, the repeated intensive شكور, and the small-input/visible-effect branch; I infer an epistemic amplification from one event to many signs. The alternative is that شكور remains only a general moral commendation.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude is the proper response after recognizing the sign.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude helps produce the recognition: it magnifies a small interruption into multiple relations of dependence, restraint, and preservation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later ethical sequence permits resistance to wrong yet repeatedly values forgiveness, reconciliation, and deliberate patience. Because the focus wind can branch as force or dominance, its stilling becomes a material analogue for arresting retaliatory momentum without confusing restraint with inability.

activation_trace.role: Wind as force and dominance supplies the power whose motion can be deliberately arrested.
Stilling supplies the physical pattern of de-escalation.
Surging anger supplies the human reactive force.
Shielding the offender from the effect of fault supplies the first arrest of retaliation.
Leaving punishment supplies chosen non-escalation after equivalent response remains available.
Removing estrangement gives restrained force a reparative direction.
Holding the self against reaction returns the focus adjective as an enacted social practice.
Firmly resolved intention prevents patience and pardon from being read as mere powerlessness.

structural_cues: 42:37-43 distinguishes retaliation, pardon, reconciliation, patience, and resolved intention.
The focus صبار returns as the finite صبر in 42:43.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies force, anger, legitimate resistance, pardon, and resolved patience; I supply the analogy between meteorological arrest and ethical de-escalation. The alternative is that the two domains are adjacent exhortations without a shared mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The patient person passively tolerates being stalled.
changed_reading.after: The patient person mirrors controlled stilling by arresting retaliatory force while retaining the capacity to act and redirecting it toward repair.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah closes by describing communication through hidden imparting, from behind a barrier, or through a messenger, then names revelation روحا and light that guides. The focus's ريح shares the life-breath root and is an unseen carrier known by its visible effects. Its withdrawal makes dependence on an imperceptible conveying current readable at the surface.

activation_trace.role: Hidden imparting supplies transmission whose source is not directly visible in its receiver.
A screening barrier sharpens the distinction between concealed agency and manifest effect.
Spirit as the life of a body activates an enlivening branch of the focus wind's root.
Illumination supplies the visible efficacy of what was conveyed.
Gentle direction toward a path supplies purposeful movement produced by the conveyed light.
Literal wind supplies an invisible current whose presence is inferred from movement.
The life-breath branch makes withdrawal of wind available as an animation analogy while remaining anchored to ريح.
Visible outward appearance supplies the surface on which hidden causation becomes manifest.

structural_cues: The surah opens with repeated revelation language and closes with its modes in 42:51-52.
ريح in 42:33 and روحا in 42:52 share the packet root ر و ح.
The visible surface term ظهر in the focus contrasts with hidden imparting and حجاب near the close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shared root, hidden modes of conveyance, life-spirit, light, guidance, and visible wind effects; I infer a common unseen-carrier mechanism. The live alternative is that the shared root merely juxtaposes distinct lexical branches with no intended analogy.

changed_reading.before: The verse offers a meteorological proof of control.
changed_reading.after: It can also materialize how unseen conveyance animates passage: when the carrier is withdrawn, visible vehicles stop, making the hidden enabling current perceptible by absence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it imports the scale into a maritime scene through a form-distant ركود branch and the ship-specific سكان branch. It remains anchored because رواكد explicitly carries a scale settling after oscillation and يسكن carries a vessel-stabilizing member, while 42:17 supplies the balance; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, not as the lexical meaning of the clause.

activation_trace.role: The ship's steering or stabilizing member makes controlled arrest mechanically native to the vessel domain.
A balance settling after oscillation supplies exact equilibrium as the quality of rest.
The balance of justice gives the settled-scale image a live whole-surah analogue.

changed_reading.before: The ships are simply deprived of speed.
changed_reading.after: The ships can resemble a balance whose motion has settled: rest is exact equilibrium, and that measured steadiness is itself the sign.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a ship onto a body and wind onto animating breath. It remains valid as an exploratory activation because the focus wind's own root contains life-spirit, 42:52 realizes that branch as روحا, and the vessel visibly passes from motion to inertness; downstream prose should say death-like or body-like suspension and must not claim that ريح lexically means soul here.

activation_trace.role: Life-spirit activates the analogy of wind as what animates an otherwise inert carrier.
Fixity after movement supplies the body's death-like loss of animation.
Loss of force and life supplies the surah's explicit contrast state for animation.
The later occurrence realizes the shared root as spirit, keeping the body analogy packet-internal.

changed_reading.before: A vessel stops when its external fuel disappears.
changed_reading.after: The vessel can be seen as a body held in reversible, death-like suspension when its animating breath is withdrawn.

strongest_changes: The adjacent shift from flowing vessels to stationary vessels makes reversible mobility, rather than grandeur alone, the sign.
The no-escape frame in 42:31 and 42:35 turns arrested navigation into a demonstration of bounded agency.
The earned-consequence and pardon pattern in 42:30 and 42:34 makes stillness a reprieve between continued travel and destruction.
The recurrence of شكور with increase makes gratitude an amplifying way of perceiving many signs in one interruption.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet joined a tight local maritime mechanism to distant but exact lexical returns: measured expansion and restraint, active patience and pardon, شكور as increase from little, and ريح/روح as an unseen enabling current. These activations preserve warning, mercy, ethics, and communication as distinct readings rather than forcing one synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet sustains both threat and merciful restraint; it does not force one value for the stopped wind.
The ريح/روح bridge is mechanically coherent but remains exploratory because shared root and hidden motion do not prove a deliberate body or revelation metaphor.
The settled-scale and ship-stabilizer branches are unusually apt material analogies but are form-distant enough to require explicit qualification.
